input_str = input().strip()

def find_substring_in_string(s, pattern, start_idx):
    for i in range(start_idx, len(s) - len(pattern) + 1):
        if s[i] == pattern[0]:
            match_found = True
            for j in range(1, len(pattern)):
                if s[i + j] != pattern[j]:
                    match_found = False
                    break
            if match_found:
                return i
    return -1

at_index = find_substring_in_string(input_str, "at", 1)
temp_str = input_str[:at_index] + '@' + input_str[at_index + 2:]
dot_index = find_substring_in_string(temp_str, "dot", 1)
start_pos = 0
output_str = ""

while dot_index != -1 and dot_index < len(temp_str) - 3:
    output_str += temp_str[start_pos:dot_index] + "."
    start_pos = dot_index + 3
    dot_index = find_substring_in_string(temp_str, "dot", start_pos)

output_str += temp_str[start_pos:]
print(output_str)
